name: Maya's Ice-Cream Stall: Demand & Supply
description: A 5-day arcade-style simulation where the learner runs Maya's Brighton Beach ice-cream stall, setting price and production under weather, cost, and competition shocks to practice reading demand, supply, and market equilibrium.
